component.name: Monadic Chat
component.summary: Chat with AI models that can use a Linux environment

description.p: Monadic Chat is a locally hosted application for creating and using AI chatbots. It gives AI models a real Linux environment through Docker, so they can run code, read documents and search the web while they answer.
It works with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, Cohere, xAI, DeepSeek and Ollama. Conversations are data you keep: you can edit, export and import them.
